query:
SELECT 
  a.subgroup,
  a.headcount as week19_headcount,
  b.headcount as week20_headcount,
  CASE WHEN a.headcount = b.headcount THEN 'SAME' ELSE 'DIFFERENT' END as status
FROM attendance_weekly a
JOIN attendance_weekly b ON a.campus = b.campus AND a.subgroup = b.subgroup AND a.year = b.year
WHERE a.year = 2026 AND a.weekNumber = 19 AND b.weekNumber = 20
  AND a.campus = 'Canton'
ORDER BY a.subgroup;
